set.body:
Scope: surface-view-javafx, corresponding surface-view example/resources and native conformance tools.

Deliverable: Move the JVM backend as an optional neurosurf4s module, preserving native readback, decoration and lifecycle behavior.

Acceptance:
- JVM compile/tests and existing pixel/pick conformance checks pass with exact revision evidence.
- An actual native display smoke is recorded; headless compilation alone is not visual acceptance.
- JavaFX is absent from shared/JS dependency graphs; native examples and assets use only provider public APIs.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U5: Move the optional JavaFX surface backend and native examples
